conflicts.permit: We encourage Users to regularly check this page for any changes to stay informed about how we are helping to look after the personal information we collect.
conflicts.prohibit: In our apps & games we do not collect, store, or share any personal information or location data.
conflicts.situation: When a user uses the studio's apps or games.
conflicts.reason: One statement explicitly denies collecting personal information in apps and games, while another directly refers to 'the personal information we collect' without carve-outs.

conflicts.permit: Some of our apps and games might use Google Analytics (third party scripts) that collect the following information and might (also) store such information as a cookie on the device you use to access our webpage: Google Analytics: (a) Demographics (browser language, country, city).
conflicts.prohibit: In our apps & games we do not collect, store, or share any personal information or location data.
conflicts.situation: When a user accesses apps or games where Google Analytics collects demographic location data such as country and city.
conflicts.reason: The policy flatly asserts no location data is collected in apps or games, yet also discloses integrating third-party tools in them that collect country and city.
